description: Run one Design Lab REPL operation. Set `action` to validate (check a UiSchema/patch against the DSL+registry) or render (an HTML document using the same record renderer and deterministic sample data as code.generate HTML: bound values, native controls, charts, tabs and honest action notices; apply=true to emit). Fragment mode retains its component-fragment contract; document output binds composed object data. Render defaults to an HTML document with token CSS; output.compact=true explicitly omits it. The inert researchContext field has been removed. BRAND (s169 m04): pass brand (a brand in the brand registry) to render a specific brand's palette; omit it for the previous behaviour, byte-identical. On dashboard.render the brand drives both the tokens inlined into the output.html export and the palette output.contrastScan grades, so what is painted and what is checked are always the same brand. Fragment output diagnoses ignored brand/output.tokenOverlay/output.skinOverlay with OODS-W001. Non-strict fragments expose OODS-W002 when OODS-V006 is reclassified per node. Document output applies scope options. validate.apply is an ignored bridge-parity key. Fragment depth and request-level dslVersion are not supported. output.payloadMode file writes the rendered document as index.html (or fragments.json and css.json) beside the saved-schema store (<store>/../payloads/repl.render-<digest>/) and returns a payload block of file references instead of html, fragments and css; a directory that cannot be written is OODS-S020.

inputSchema.description: Grouped action-parameter tool consolidating repl.render and repl.validate. Select the per-action body via the top-level `action` discriminator. Each branch reproduces the exact body of the corresponding per-action input schema, with `action` added to the allowed property set. Per-action handlers, schemas, and the external repl_render/repl_validate tools are unchanged; this is a zero-functionality-loss bolt-on.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler. 'render' -> repl.render, 'validate' -> repl.validate.

apply.description: For render: When true and the schema validates, render it: the HTML document in html, or per-node fragments with output.format 'fragments'. Omitted or false is a dry run that validates and returns the tree with no HTML. For validate: Accepted for bridge dry-run/apply mode parity (this tool is apply-capable); ignored by this action. Actions: render, validate.

baseTree.description: Required when mode='patch' to provide the base UiSchema to patch. (complex schema — see server docs) Actions: render, validate.

brand.description: Brand to render (s169 m04). Optional with NO default: omitting it preserves the previous behaviour byte-for-byte, including the document's data-brand="default". Uppercase 'A' or 'B' exactly. Applies to output.format='document' only — the 'fragments' branch emits no <html> element to carry data-brand, so fragments diagnose an ignored brand with OODS-W001. Actions: render.

checkA11y.description: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against current built tokens for every registered brand and theme, including team brands. With a UiSchema, renders through the shared HTML renderer and checks document language/title, one main landmark, unique IDs, ARIA reference targets, control names/labels, image alternatives, chart SVG name/description, and heading names/order. Reports unresolved inherited surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha compositing and OS colours as unmeasured. Does not check browser-computed colour/layout, keyboard/focus interaction or screen-reader behavior; no complete WCAG conformance claim. Only for validate.

output.description: Optional render output controls. Omitting this object preserves full-document behavior. Actions: render.

compact.description: Opt in to omitting token CSS; the default includes token CSS.

confidenceThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for low-confidence affordance. Components with confidence below this value receive the oods-low-confidence CSS class. Only effective when showConfidence is true. Default 0.5.

payloadMode.description: inline (default) returns html (or fragments and css) in the response. file writes index.html (or fragments.json and css.json) beside the saved-schema store (<store>/../payloads/repl.render-<digest>/) and returns a payload block of file references instead; html, fragments and css are then omitted.

showConfidence.description: When true, emit data-oods-confidence and data-confidence-level attributes on rendered components that carry composition confidence metadata. Low-confidence components (below confidenceThreshold) also receive an oods-low-confidence CSS class. Default false.

skinOverlay.description: Inline measured-COLOUR delta resolved against the OODS Foundry-owned style library to a scoped :root{} override on the --sys-/--ref- skin (distinct from tokenOverlay's --oods- token path); applied only in document output (format=document), gated by apply===true. An unmapped logical key fails loud with OODS-V140. Lands in the same components <style> block as tokenOverlay; default-absent is byte-identical.

tokenOverlay.description: Inline token-delta object resolved to a scoped :root{} override; applied only in document output (format=document), diagnosed as ignored for fragments with OODS-W001; distinct from the FS-resolved named brandOverlay on fidelity.preview.

patch.description: Required when mode='patch'. Accepts JSON Patch array or node patch object(s). (complex schema — see server docs) Actions: render, validate.

schema.description: (complex schema — see server docs) Actions: render, validate.

schemaRef.description: Reference to a cached UiSchema returned by design.compose. Actions: render, validate.

name: repl
